{
  "problem": "Design a minimal REST API for managing tasks, with the response delivered as a JSON structure.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define core REST endpoints for basic task operations (create, read, update, delete)",
    "Specify request and response payload formats",
    "Keep the API design simple and focused on essential functionality",
    "Format the final API specification or examples as valid JSON"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Must adhere to REST architectural principles",
    "Must remain minimal in scope and complexity",
    "Output must be structured as JSON"
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Implementing authentication, authorization, or user management",
    "Designing database schemas, server logic, or deployment configurations",
    "Adding advanced features like pagination, filtering, sorting, or webhooks",
    "Building frontend interfaces or client applications"
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What specific fields should the task resource contain (e.g., id, title, description, status, due_date)?",
    "Should the JSON output represent an OpenAPI/Swagger specification, or just example request/response payloads?",
    "Are there specific HTTP status codes or error response formats to follow?",
    "Should the API include URL versioning (e.g., /v1/tasks)?"
  ],
  "raw_prompt": "Diseña una API REST minimal para gestionar tareas. Responde con estructura JSON."
}
